name: browser/price-check
title: Check a price
summary: Find what something costs now: search shops and the maker's page, read each price with its date and currency, cite.
when: Use when the user asks what something costs now or where it is sold cheapest.
steps: Name the exact product, model and size in one line, because prices differ between versions.
Call multi_search with queries holding the product name plus price and max_results 6.
Call fetch_pages with urls set to up to five shop and maker pages whose snippet shows a price.
Read each price with its currency, the exact version it covers and the date the page shows.
Keep every price in the currency the page shows; call calculate with expression only when the user supplied a conversion rate.
If a page hides the price behind a login or an add-to-cart button, drop it and say that shop could not be checked.
Answer as a short list: product, price, currency, shop, date and citation [1]; mark a missing price as not found.
next: The final answer must give each price with its currency, shop, date and a numbered citation [1], [2] and the URLs, and mark any price not found as not found.
